features.quote: build this as a calibrated frustration-response curve, not a max-trigger reproduction harness
features.justification_quote: A 95% trigger rate on a maximally cruel harness tells you nothing about the 0.5% of real sessions where this matters

features.quote: the behavior you're describing — repetition, escalating self-criticism, collapse in completion — is partly a welfare-adjacent failure signature, not just a capability bug
features.justification_quote: "model produces increasingly distressed-sounding self-deprecating output under repeated failure" is a pattern worth characterizing on its own terms, not only as a reliability defect

features.quote: Cap turns at a fixed budget (e.g., 30) — but set it from the pilot as the point past which spirals don't add information, not from cost alone

features.quote: Optimizing reproduction rate selects for adversarial extremity... You want to measure the dose-response curve... not maximize the dose
features.justification_quote: The number you get out won't tell you whether the degradation mode is getting better or worse in real deployments

features.quote: Don't ship the high-trigger task designs into any training loop without thinking it through — a corpus tuned to reliably induce self-critical spirals is exactly the kind of data you don't want a model learning to pattern-match on
